limits: 10 fictional pages, one example per language and shape, not independent real-world samples.
All40 inferences in each matrix completed; completion is not literal correctness. Errors, mismatches and unsupported relationships remain in per-case results.
No orientation detection, table-line removal, inferred table merge/graph semantics or stamp authentication.
Model hash checks warm/read the weights; OS cache and unrelated machine activity uncontrolled.
No actual real private corpus or proprietary frontier comparison. No production/provider activation.

reviewCorrection.P2: Bad IDAT CRC preserves failed row and remaining successful case; numeric punctuation continuations no longer count as critical literal matches. Both regressions failed before correction, then passed. Existing prepared quality counts are unchanged under corrected critical metric.
reviewCorrection.ciTests: 14 stdlib tests, including native fake-child timeout/interruption kill and reaping; optional real failure probe uses installed pinned models.
